subject: POC success path: sprint card, acceptance gates & stall-breakers
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@firmbridge.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@firmbridge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC success path: sprint card, acceptance gates & stall-breakers

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on scope. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can keep momentum:

1) Success criteria (proposal)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for 512-token requests during business hours
- Quality: top-line intent accuracy >= 92% on your 250-item eval set
- Cost: steady-state cost target <= $0.018 per 1k tokens (configured via batching + cache)

2) Suggested eval plan
- Week 1: baseline capture + smoke validation (sample_eval_set_v2.csv attached)
- Week 2: iterative tuning (batching/quantization) and 1st canary run
- Week 3: final acceptance run and handoff to Prod (redwood dedicated pool)

3) Ownership (please confirm)
- FirmBridge: provide final 250-item gold set, traffic shape, and security questionnaire answers (Priya)
- Redwood: deliver canary config, security matrix, and test window coordination (Irene / Aditya)

4) Blockers & "stall-breakers" (what stops the trial)
- Missing gold eval set (blocks Week 1)
- API token rotation + IP allowlist on your side (blocks canary)
- SOC2 evidence request timeline (may require dedicated review)

Ask: Can you confirm owners and whether the week-of April 5 works for the first canary window? If we get the gold set and security matrix by April 1, we can keep to the three-week cadence above.

Attachments: FirmBridge_Security_Matrix_v1.pdf, sample_eval_set_v2.csv

Thanks — I’ll assign internal tasks after you confirm owners.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@firmbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@firmbridge.com>, DevOps Team <devops@firmbridge.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC success path: sprint card, acceptance gates & stall-breakers

Appreciate the clear summary, Irene. Priya and I spoke and confirmed:
- We can deliver the 250 gold items by end of day March 31 (will be a CSV + short rationale column).
- Security matrix: sending our completed matrix in a separate email (it includes our SOC2 auditor contact).
- API token rotation: that is owned by our DevOps team — they need a short checklist from Redwood of required IP ranges and token scopes.

We agree to the proposed cadence, April 5 week for the canary works for us. One ask: can Redwood's canary include a short A/B variant (baseline model + quantized variant) so we can compare latency and quality side-by-side?

Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product, FirmBridge

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-30T13:03:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: tasking for FirmBridge POC (owners + deliverables)

Quick internal split of work after FirmBridge confirmed owners and canary week (April 5):
- Aditya: build canary config + A/B route (baseline vs quantized). Deliverable: canary playbook and canary-window-diagram.png by April 2 EOD. Blocker: need to confirm IP allowlist/ranges.
- Marissa: prepare eval harness and acceptance checklist; convert their CSV into our evaluation runner. Deliverable: evaluation report template by April 3.
- Sergio: pre-stage a small dedicated pool and reserve burst capacity for the canary run. Deliverable: cost estimate and pool ARN.

Known risk: DevOps on their side rotates tokens weekly — ask for a pre-canary freeze window. I will request the freeze and ask Priya to confirm.

Cc'ing outreach notes into the HubSpot deal. I'll update the record after we get their security matrix.

Irene

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: tasking for FirmBridge POC (owners + deliverables)

Status update:
- Canary config: initial canary + A/B routing prototype is ready. See notes (api_token_rotation_notes.txt attached) — we need FirmBridge DevOps to whitelist these CIDR ranges: 34.82.120.0/24 and 34.82.121.0/24.
- Quantized variant: running locally, latency expected to drop ~22% at 512 tokens; need real traffic to validate quality delta.
- ETA: canary playbook + diagram posted to the Drive by EOD April 2.

Blocker: Priya mentioned SOC2 auditor wants a short list of logs for evidence; I'll draft a one-page log export spec for them.

–Aditya

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@firmbridge.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@firmbridge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly check-in: April 5 canary window & immediate asks

Hi Liam/Priya — weekly pulse and a couple of immediate asks to avoid any slip: 

1) Deliverables we still need from FirmBridge by April 1 EOD (please confirm):
- Final 250 gold eval CSV (Priya) — status?
- IP allowlist confirmation or a freeze window for token rotation (DevOps)
- Completed security matrix (we received an initial version; any outstanding fields?)

2) Redwood commitments this week:
- Canary playbook + diagram (Aditya) — delivering April 2 EOD (attached)
- Eval harness template (Marissa) — delivering April 3
- SOC2 log export spec (Aditya/Sergio) — drafting and sharing by April 2

3) Next steps and meeting cadence:
- Canary kickoff call: Tue April 6, 10:00am PT (proposed) — can we lock this?
- Post-canary readout: one-hour slot the following week for side-by-side results

If you can reply with simple yes/no on the three FirmBridge deliverables and confirm the April 6 kickoff, we will finalize the canary schedule and reserve the dedicated pool.

Thanks — appreciate the quick replies to keep this moving.

Irene
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
